---
title: "MLS Match Scoring Before and After Messi"
format:
  html:
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

mls <- read_csv("data/mls_modern.csv")

messi_cutoff <- as.Date("2023-07-21")

mls <- mls %>%
  mutate(Date = dmy(Date)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HG), !is.na(AG)) %>%
  mutate(
    total_goals = HG + AG,
    era = if_else(
      Date < messi_cutoff,
      "Pre-Messi Era (2012–July 2023)",
      "Messi Era (July 2023–2026)"
    ),
    inter_miami = Home == "Inter Miami CF" | Away == "Inter Miami CF" |
      Home == "Inter Miami" | Away == "Inter Miami",
    point_group = if_else(inter_miami, "Inter Miami CF", era)
  )

era_summary <- mls %>%
  group_by(era) %>%
  summarise(
    matches = n(),
    mean_goals = mean(total_goals),
    draw_rate = mean(HG == AG),
    mean_goal_margin = mean(abs(HG - AG)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

inter_miami_summary <- mls %>%
  filter(inter_miami, Date >= messi_cutoff) %>%
  summarise(
    matches = n(),
    wins = sum(
      (Home %in% c("Inter Miami CF", "Inter Miami") & HG > AG) |
        (Away %in% c("Inter Miami CF", "Inter Miami") & AG > HG)
    ),
    draws = sum(HG == AG),
    losses = sum(
      (Home %in% c("Inter Miami CF", "Inter Miami") & HG < AG) |
        (Away %in% c("Inter Miami CF", "Inter Miami") & AG < HG)
    ),
    goals_for = mean(if_else(
      Home %in% c("Inter Miami CF", "Inter Miami"), HG, AG
    )),
    goals_against = mean(if_else(
      Home %in% c("Inter Miami CF", "Inter Miami"), AG, HG
    ))
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(mls, aes(x = Date, y = total_goals, color = point_group)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.25, height = 0.25, width = 0) +
  geom_smooth(
    data = mls,
    aes(x = Date, y = total_goals, color = era, group = era),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    method = "loess",
    se = TRUE,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Pre-Messi Era (2012–July 2023)" = "#1f4e78",
      "Messi Era (July 2023–2026)" = "#d9534f",
      "Inter Miami CF" = "#f7b5cd"
    )
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, title.position = "top")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(
    title = "Goals per MLS Match Over Time",
    subtitle = "n = 6,326 real MLS matches, 2012–2026",
    x = "Match date",
    y = "Total goals",
    color = "Match group",
    caption = "Source: Football-Data.co.uk MLS Match Records"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```

Match scoring rose modestly after July 21, 2023: average goals increased from `r sprintf("%.2f", era_summary$mean_goals[era_summary$era == "Pre-Messi Era (2012–July 2023)"])` before the cutoff to `r sprintf("%.2f", era_summary$mean_goals[era_summary$era == "Messi Era (July 2023–2026)"])` afterward. Draws remained about one quarter of matches (`r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * era_summary$draw_rate[era_summary$era == "Pre-Messi Era (2012–July 2023)"])` before and `r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * era_summary$draw_rate[era_summary$era == "Messi Era (July 2023–2026)"])` after), and the average goal margin was nearly unchanged (`r sprintf("%.2f", era_summary$mean_goal_margin[era_summary$era == "Pre-Messi Era (2012–July 2023)"])` versus `r sprintf("%.2f", era_summary$mean_goal_margin[era_summary$era == "Messi Era (July 2023–2026)"])`). The records point to somewhat higher scoring, but not a clear shift in overall competitiveness. Since the cutoff, Inter Miami recorded `r inter_miami_summary$wins` wins, `r inter_miami_summary$draws` draws, and `r inter_miami_summary$losses` losses in `r inter_miami_summary$matches` matches, averaging `r sprintf("%.2f", inter_miami_summary$goals_for)` goals scored and `r sprintf("%.2f", inter_miami_summary$goals_against)` conceded per match. The source lists the club as “Inter Miami”; the chart highlights those matches in pink. These comparisons describe the records and do not establish that Messi caused league-wide changes.
